text:
Maria: CI publish failed on PR #6289 when pushing image to our registry — job error: 'failed to upload blob: unexpected EOF'. Local push works.
Raj: can you paste the job log/artifact link?
Maria: attaching key snippet from job: 
```
2024-08-12T14:32:08Z info: pushing layer 6a3f...
2024-08-12T14:32:10Z error: failed to upload blob: unexpected EOF
http2: response.Body.Read: EOF
```
ci-bot: job 5678 failed (push step) — retry recommended.
Cameron: this smells like huge build context / tar stream truncation we saw before when symlinks pulled large dirs into the context. any recent Dockerfile/context changes?
Maria: we changed Dockerfile to `COPY ./app /app` last week. dev added a `shared_cache -> ../.cache/builds` symlink under `app`. .dockerignore doesn't mention the cache dir.
Raj: check artifact `build-context.tar.gz` size in job artifacts?
Kai: I saw it: ~1.2GB in CI artifact. that's probably the issue — registry aborts on large upload or network glitch during large blob.
Maria: tried rerun with `--no-cache` (CI flag) — still failed at same step.
Cameron: can you reproduce locally with buildx? try: `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker buildx build --push --file Dockerfile .` — watch the tar stream size.
Maria: reproducing locally now, grabbing `docker buildx` log.
Raj: short-term fix: add `.dockerignore` entry to exclude `app/shared_cache` (or make symlink relative to ignored path).
Kai: also consider changing Dockerfile to `COPY --from=builder /app/dist /app` (build in stage) so context doesn't include the symlink target.
Maria: opened small PR 6290 that adds `.dockerignore` rules for `**/shared_cache/**` and excludes `.cache` directories. requesting fast review.
opsbot: rerun requested by @Maria for pipeline 5678 (new run queued).
Cameron: i'll try to bisect — will test commits between before/after Dockerfile change to confirm root cause. can you keep the rerun queued?
Maria: yes, leaving queued.
Raj: long-term: add a CI guard that fails early if build context > 100MB (upload artifact size check). I can file an issue.
Kai: agree. also add a linter check on PRs that warns about adding large symlinked dirs.
Maria: quick note: pushing the same image to our staging registry from local with big context succeeded once, failed intermittently. so network + size combined. we should avoid having large contexts at all.
Cameron: created issue #782 to add size guard + docs on proper dockerignore hygiene.
Maria: PR 6290 merged after a quick +1 from @Kai, re-running main pipeline.
ci-bot: rerun succeeded — push step completed. image digest: sha256:abc123...
Maria: thanks all. follow-up actions: (1) add CI context-size check (issue #782), (2) doc note about symlinked caches, (3) monitor for similar EOFs. closing thread. :thumbsup:
